svg.aria-label: A timeline of the 67 cycles of the card's stress run on three images, and a table of the legs run on each: 4,086 legs, 4,032 passed, 54 skipped by design, none failed.
svg.title: A timeline of the 67 cycles of the card's stress run on three images, and a table of the legs run on each: 4,086 legs, 4,032 passed, 54 skipped by design, none failed.
svg.text: The card's long run: what ran, and what passed
The card's long run (card-stress-1016), 2026-10-16 18:58 to 2026-10-19 08:01 on the box's clock: it cycled through
its three images (u50-rev8-quad, u50-rev8, u50-rev8-deep), weighted 4 to 1 to 1, and on each visit but the last ran a
battery of the card's own tests and then a slice of the native-oracle sweeps. No leg failed.
cycles, by image: the battery (dark) then the sweep slices (light)
legs by image: passed (skipped by design), and the median time of a passing run
The 54 skips are by design and each carries its reason in the record - acceptance-rev8 on single: the revision-8 set has no entry for
u50-rev8: its rule puts a workload on the single only where R21 alone keeps it off the quad, which none does (programs/acceptance.py,
REV8); selftest on quad and single and deep: every 3 visits of an image. Every other leg ran on every visit but the last and passed; the
last visit (the quad's 45th, cycle 67) was cut by the deadline after 7 of the battery's 12 legs, so seq-check, acceptance, acceptance-rev8,
resident and selftest were reached, run or skipped by design, on 44 of its 45 visits (selftest's cell reads 15 passes and 29 skips, 44 in
all) and it ran no sweep slice.
